message: x-fern-streaming must be true or an object. Fern ignores any other value, so endpoint stringExtension does not stream.
x-fern-streaming format must be 'sse' or 'json'. Fern ignores x-fern-streaming with another format, so endpoint badFormat does not stream.
x-fern-streaming resumable must be a boolean. Fern treats any other value as false.
x-fern-streaming stream-description must be a string.
x-fern-streaming terminator must be a string.
x-fern-streaming resumable only applies to server-sent events; set format: sse or remove resumable.
